meaning: ST I q.3 a.1 co., second proof, for the prima via's mover: the first mover moved by none is the first being (open premise, Aquinas' back-reference), and the first being is in no way in potency, so every first mover moved by none is pure act. The Comparator config also verifies firstWayDoesNotYieldPureAct: the prima via premises plus act priority do not yield pure act without the first-being premise.
